methods_quotes.q: Trends during the analysis period were analyzed using Joinpoint regression (version 4.9.1.0; National Cancer Institute)
The average 4-week period percentage change (APPC) was calculated as the average of the slope coefficients of the Joinpoint regression line.
E-cigarette unit sales were standardized and summed during 4-week periods
Consistent with previous studies, unit sales were standardized to reflect the most common package size for each product type.
